summary: Approved. Diff base 1cdbc303...90cbe643 touches only SearchDialog.astro's markup shell + scoped style, the new e2e spec, the four allowlisted evidence artifacts, and force-added .tmp RED/GREEN scratch (established sprint convention — merged ORI-VIS-001 did the same); zero changes to search-dialog.ts, Header.astro, scripts/**, indexing or focus logic. The flagged native method=dialog close form is adjudicated IN: the task's own ACs require an observable close action AST-004 never shipped, it adds zero JS, and it rides the island's existing close-event listener (search-dialog.ts:147-149) so keyboard/focus/navigation semantics are unchanged — the 'Ask first' clause was discharged by flagging it to this review. The dead-CSS key finding is verified two ways: by code (createElement-built result nodes carry no Astro scoping attribute, so the scoped .search-dialog__result*/__group-label rules could never match) and empirically (RED captures show the pre-change active result completely unstyled; the :global() replacements anchored on .search-dialog__scroll demonstrably style the built results). loadingSeen=false is accepted under the task's explicit 'Loading may be brief' observation carve-out — the poll imposes no delay and the observation is honestly recorded in both the implementer's and my run; fallow-ignore-next-line is the repo's documented lint idiom, not an assertion skip. All four gates re-verified fresh by the reviewer: build exit 0 ([search-index] index complete: 64 pages cover all 63 expected destinations), pnpm typecheck exit 0, biome ci (direct binary) exit 0, and playwright 8/8 across chromium-desktop + chromium-mobile with CI=true on the owned port. Non-blocking notes for the merger: untracked apps/docs/playwright-report/ and test-results/ dirs remain in the worktree (not gitignored, not committed — do not sweep them into the merge), and the committed evidence JSON records gitHead c28e40c2 (captured pre-commit) but binds correctness through content hashes that match this commit exactly.
